name_input: M/S I.B.M INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; M/S IBM INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; IBM INDIA PVT.LTD; IBM INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED; IBM INDIA PVT LTD
export_evidence: No export record found. The only accessible shipment source (ImportKey, slug 'ibm-india-private-limited') shows IBM India exclusively as an IMPORTER/BUYER, not as a shipper: "2026-02-28 | IBM CORPORATION | IBM INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED | 35P2615 ADP TAPE DRIVE UNIT, INTERNAL LIMITED CRYPTO 027866 | NEW YORK, CHINA | BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India | 84717040 | BOL 7799460" — direction is origin=New York/China, destination=Bangalore ACC, i.e. inbound. Counter check: page header states "Total Shipments 18791 Records detected", "Trading Partners 74", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28"; rows actually visible on the free view: 5 shipment rows (all imports), 5 supplier rows, 5 buyer rows. No outbound B/L with an Indian port of loading and a foreign destination was seen. Slug variant 'ibm-india-pvt-ltd' returned an empty record set ("Loading...", no rows). volza, eximpedia, trademo and thecompanycheck all returned HTTP 403 on free access, so export side could not be verified either way.
domestic_evidence: No domestic-supply record could be retrieved. GeM/CPPP tender pages, GST turnover band and annual-report India splits were not accessible within the tool budget (zaubacorp and thecompanycheck returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo search backend was down — 'searx: Connection refused'). No GST turnover figure, contract or public-procurement award line was actually seen, so no number is asserted.
note: HS 847170 is consistent with the observed import lines (84717040 'ADP TAPE DRIVE UNIT' on BOL 7799460, 2026-02-28), so the declared code is plausible for this entity's trade profile — but the observed trade is inbound only. IMPORTANT: the verified evidence proves IBM India RECEIVES goods into India (18791 import records, latest 2026-02-28, ports Bangalore ACC INBLR4 / Singapore / Guadalajara / Cincinnati OH); it does NOT prove export shipments or domestic supply. Per Rule 5, no shipment claim is upgraded on the strength of the company being a large multinational: export_status and domestic_status are left as unknown, not 'confirmed'. No export B/L with date, destination and HS code was found, and no GST/tender/contract evidence was retrieved — so this is 'следов поставок не найдено' on the export and domestic side within the sources actually read, not a confirmation. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in the sources read; not invented). No CIN/PAN asserted — the CIN in the attempted URL was not verified from a page that loaded, so it is not reported. Recommended next step: paid Volza/Eximpedia export view or DGFT/GeM lookup to settle export_status and domestic_status.
